title: SENSOR NOT FOUND
symptom: After changing sensor and replacing MiaoMiao, xDrip shows 'SENSOR NOT FOUND' error, although the sensor works fine on the Libre monitor. The error persists even after resetting MiaoMiao and ensuring it is tightly placed.
cause: The issue appears to be a problem of the sensor in combination with MiaoMiao, not related to xDrip.
evidence_quote: It looks like a problem of the sensor in combination with Miaomiao and not related to xDrip.
